name: app-grocery-onboarding-in-warm-yellow-with-diet-chips-and-hero-phone
title: Cream-yellow grocery onboarding: trust promise with a shopper on yellow, scrolling diet chips in pastel colours, and a grocery bag from a phone
whatItIs: Three phones on soft cream blur: a screen with a woman holding a basket in front of a phone on a yellow card, 'Over 1 Million Members Trust Us' and a checklist, a screen with overflowing rows of colourful diet chips (Organic, Gluten-Free, Dairy Free, Low Sugar, Keto, Whole 30, Vegetarian, Vegan) under 'The Easiest way To Shop Healthy', and a screen with a grocery bag emerging from a phone and 'Build Your Order', each with an orange Next or Get Started button.
whatItMeans: Friendly and appetising; scrolling colourful chips make diets feel like ingredients.
techniques: Make diet choices rows of cropped coloured chips.
Pair each screen with a playful illustration.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded tile with an icon and diet name.
Rows of chips cut by the screen edge.
A member count with a short benefit list.
A drawing of a product coming out of a phone.
